lines: To still the world by loosing it — rule of doubt-fear, then ban —
You show, having made Yama. Split doubt again, great goddess, grind my world-fear fine.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jagatsaṃhāreṇa praśamayitukāmaḥ | mahādevī seyaṃ mama bhavabhayaṃ saṃdalayatām

verses.craft: Rule-then-ban pair per UNC; Yama-emitted; grind-fine close.
